claims.content: The MSIU salesperson's details have been captured in the system and stored in the Database within the MSIU Sales Team Information Master module.

The captured salesperson record contains Salesman Code, Name of the Salesman, DOB & Age, Gender, Communication Address, Contact No, E-Mail Id, and a reference to a Sales-team maintained in a separate master.
The system has checked the Salesman Code and referenced Sales-team ID for duplicates; if a duplicate was found, a warning message was issued allowing the user to keep the duplicate name or change it.
